nodes.label: SSH Deploy Key + systemd Deployment Strategy
nodes.rationale: A deploy key avoids storing a personal access token on a single-purpose VM. systemd is already part of Ubuntu, adds no process-manager dependency, restarts failed processes, and starts them on boot.
nodes.norm_label: ssh deploy key + systemd deployment strategy

nodes.label: vm-logger-monitor systemd timer
nodes.rationale: Runs the one-minute health check independently of the loggers so monitoring keeps working even if a logger service is down.

nodes.label: liquidation-heatmap systemd timer
nodes.rationale: Uses fixed UTC calendar times (00:00, 07:00, 13:00, 17:00, 21:00) for exactly five scheduled Actor runs per day, bounding Apify Actor usage/cost.

nodes.label: BT001_MACHINE_ID
nodes.rationale: The VM must receive a new permanent machine ID; never copy a browser/laptop identifier, so DB rows can be reliably filtered to the VM's own writes during verification.

nodes.label: monitoring_incidents table
nodes.rationale: Incident details must remain operational metadata and must never include credentials; rows are de-duplicated per incident.

nodes.label: scalp_positions table
nodes.rationale: Must show zero VM rows in the scalp-signal-logger verification window; the scalper signal pipeline has no position-writing capability.

nodes.label: scalp_trades table
nodes.rationale: Must show zero VM rows in the scalp-signal-logger verification window; the scalper signal pipeline has no trade-writing capability.

nodes.label: scalp_operational table
nodes.rationale: Must show zero VM rows in the scalp-signal-logger verification window; the scalper signal pipeline has no operational-logging capability.

nodes.label: GR client-order-ID ownership markers (GR_ENTRY_/GR_PROT_/GR_EXIT_)
nodes.rationale: Binance ownership is proven only by section-specific client-order IDs beginning with GR_ENTRY_, GR_PROT_, or GR_EXIT_. Orders without those markers are treated as external/manual and are never imported or modified by GR, preventing accidental interference with manual trades.

nodes.label: Read-only browser heatmap architecture
nodes.rationale: The browser heatmap is a read-only consumer of the latest normalized snapshot in liquidation_heatmap_snapshots; it never calls Apify or CoinAnk. Apify credentials and Actor execution exist only in headless/pull-liquidation-heatmap.js on the VM, keeping third-party credentials out of the browser.

nodes.label: headless:scalper pipeline (V1/V2 signal detectors)
nodes.rationale: V1 writes qualified detections only to scalp_v1_signals; V2 writes qualified detections only to scalp_v2_signals. Neither detector has account, position, order, trade, operational logging, or SSSC integration capability, keeping signal detection isolated from execution.

nodes.label: headless:monitor health check
nodes.rationale: One-shot command scheduled every minute by the systemd timer; records one unresolved incident per check within a six-hour de-duplication window and exits status 1 when unhealthy.

nodes.label: BT001_MACHINE_ID (headless runners)
nodes.rationale: Must uniquely identify this deployment; the runners deliberately provide no generated or default ID.

nodes.norm_label: index.html (btc futures realtime chart app shell)

nodes.label: Scalper account Binance API keys modal
nodes.rationale: This account is used ONLY by the SCALP module when its "Enable Scalper" toggle is on -- never by the main chart, manual trading, or calculator, isolating scalper credentials/risk from other trading surfaces.
nodes.norm_label: scalper account binance api keys modal

nodes.label: SCALP Supabase auto-entry log settings
nodes.rationale: Project URL and anon key are used only to INSERT decision-log rows for SCALP auto-entry review; stored locally in the browser after Save, never pre-populated, and the input field is cleared immediately after saving to limit credential exposure.

nodes.label: Strategy Lab (GPT analysis)
nodes.rationale: Uses handov1 multi-timeframe data and an IndexedDB candle cache; position management can be added later.
